sources.title: Architector for high-throughput cross-periodic table 3D complex building
sources.evidence: API and capability context; aromatic sandwich groups use three facial template slots. Not evidence for a particular designed molecule.
sources.bibliographic_title: Architector for high-throughput cross-periodic table 3D complex building

sources.title: Slow Inversion of Coordinated Thioether Groups in SNS-Type Ruthenium Pincer Complexes
sources.evidence: Exact S03 connectivity and three sulfur diastereomers; experimentally measured exchange, with activation Gibbs energies 65-70 kJ/mol.
sources.bibliographic_title: Slow Inversion of Coordinated Thioether Groups in SNS‐Type Ruthenium Pincer Complexes

sources.evidence: Exact mixed N2/N2S coordination motif for S04. Related N2S targets S01/S02 are designed derivatives, not structures established by this paper.

sources.title: Synthesis and characterisation of bite angle-dependent (eta1-allyl)Rh and (eta3-allyl)Rh complexes bearing diphosphine ligands
sources.evidence: Experimental coupling of bite angle and allyl binding mode; catalytic relevance. Supplies mechanism context, not coordinates or a population reference for the authored Pd allyl target.
sources.bibliographic_title: Synthesis and characterisation of bite angle-dependent (η1-allyl)Rh and (η3-allyl)Rh complexes bearing diphosphine ligands. Implications for nucleophilic substitution reactions

sources.title: The Effect of the Regiochemistry of Butyl Amide Substituents on the Solution-State Structures of Lanthanide(III) DOTA-tetraamide Complexes
sources.evidence: Solution SAP/TSAP isomers and butyl-amide substitution effects; the cited DTMA 3.2:1 ratio is contextual until temperature and medium are recovered. The four fixed S centers of D02 are explicit authored stereochemistry.
sources.bibliographic_title: Effect of the Regiochemistry of Butyl Amide Substituents on the Solution-State Structures of Lanthanide(III) DOTA-Tetraamide Complexes

sources.title: p-SCN-Bn-HOPO: A Superior Bifunctional Chelator for 89Zr ImmunoPET
sources.evidence: The paper reports a Zr complex of unfunctionalized 3,4,3-LI(1,2-HOPO) with all eight O donors bound. D03 uses that unfunctionalized chelator, not the antibody-conjugation derivative in the title.
sources.bibliographic_title: p-SCN-Bn-HOPO: A Superior Bifunctional Chelator for 89Zr ImmunoPET

sources.title: Water Stability and Luminescence of Lanthanide Complexes of Tripodal Ligands Derived from 1,4,7-Triazacyclononane: Pyridinecarboxamide versus Pyridinecarboxylate Donors
sources.evidence: Establishes the TACN/picolinate ligand family. This study examines Eu/Tb; D05's Lu substitution is a motif-level selection, not an exact reference structure from this paper.
sources.bibliographic_title: Water Stability and Luminescence of Lanthanide Complexes of Tripodal Ligands Derived from 1,4,7‐Triazacyclononane: Pyridinecarboxamide versus Pyridinecarboxylate Donors

sources.title: X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy and Density Functional Theory Studies of [(H3buea)FeIII-X]n- (X = S2-, O2-, OH-)
sources.evidence: Primary/secondary sphere and hydrogen-bonded Fe-hydroxo chemistry for P01; P02 is a deliberately designed NH-blocked analogue.
sources.bibliographic_title: X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy and Density Functional Theory Studies of [(H3buea)FeIII-X]n- (X = S2-, O2-, OH-):  Comparison of Bonding and Hydrogen Bonding in Oxo and Sulfido Complexes

sources.title: A trans-dinitrogen complex of molybdenum
sources.evidence: Establishes a diphosphine-supported trans-Mo dinitrogen motif using dppe. N01 uses depe; this source alone does not establish its exact geometry or cis population.

sources.title: Experimental and Theoretical EPR Study of Jahn-Teller-Active [HIPTN3N]MoL Complexes (L = N2, CO, NH3)
sources.evidence: Low-spin d3 Mo in a protected triamidoamine pocket. N02 is a smaller Dipp-substituted designed model; measured spin/vibronic properties of HIPTN3N are not transferred as ground truth.
sources.bibliographic_title: Experimental and Theoretical EPR Study of Jahn−Teller-Active [HIPTN<sub>3</sub>N]MoL Complexes (L = N<sub>2</sub>, CO, NH<sub>3</sub>)

sources.title: Hinged and Wide: A New P^P Ligand for Emissive [Cu(P^P)(N^N)][PF6] Complexes
sources.evidence: Mechanism context for hinged/wide P,P chelates, interligand packing and Cu(I) luminescence. Not an experimental structure for every substituent combination in B04.
sources.bibliographic_title: Hinged and Wide: A New P^P Ligand for Emissive [Cu(P^P)(N^N)][PF6] Complexes

sources.title: XL-Xantphos: Design and Synthesis of a Mechanistic Probe of Xantphos O-Coordination in Catalytic Reactions
sources.evidence: Matched Xantphos/XL-Xantphos Pd(II) systems have opposite computed cis/trans preferences. A computed preference is neither a barrier nor a measured thermal population.
sources.bibliographic_title: XL-Xantphos: Design and Synthesis of a Mechanistic Probe of Xantphos O-Coordination in Catalytic Reactions
